name: Browser Retrieval
description: Retrieve node-reachable JavaScript-rendered webpages as bounded, untrusted text and structured data, and download files into shared artifact storage.
capabilities: read JavaScript-rendered webpages as Markdown or plain text
inspect headings and links on rendered webpages
discover repeated link patterns and candidate CSS selectors
extract selected fields from rendered webpage elements
extract structured tables from rendered webpages
download a PDF or image from a URL into shared artifact storage

downloadContact.description: Operator contact URL or email appended to the web_download User-Agent, as sites such as Wikimedia request for automated clients.
